offers.title: Apple Watch Series 12
offers.summary: Smartwatch in 42 mm and 46 mm. Up to 24 h normal use, 38 h in Low Power Mode, up to 80% in about 30 min. Water resistant to 50 m (ISO 22810:2010), IP6X. ECG, blood oxygen and temperature sensors. Requires iPhone 11 or later with iOS 27.

specs.name: sensors
specs.value: ECG, optical heart, blood oxygen, temperature, depth gauge to 6 m

specs.name: phone_compatibility
specs.value: iPhone 11 or later with iOS 27 or later

claims.statement: Up to 24 hours normal use and 38 hours in Low Power Mode
Water resistant to 50 m under ISO 22810:2010; IP6X dust

suitable_for: iPhone users who want ECG and blood oxygen readings on the wrist
Swimmers who want a water-resistant watch
not_suitable_for: Android phone users: it requires an iPhone 11 or later
People who want several days per charge: rated 24 hours of normal use

offers.title: Samsung Galaxy Watch8
offers.summary: Smartwatch in 40 mm and 44 mm with a 3000-nit display. ECG, irregular-rhythm alerts, sleep apnea detection, cuff-calibrated blood pressure and body composition. Pairs with Android 11 or later phones with at least 1.5 GB memory.
